$comment: Gzip size budgets for the built web assets, checked by `pnpm perf:check` after `pnpm build`. Set from the template's measured build rounded up: the initial JavaScript (every visit) 104 kB, the error tracking chunk (fetched only when WEB_SENTRY_DSN is set) 31 kB, the Web Vitals chunks (fetched after the first render, the library only for sampled page loads) 4.2 kB, CSS 0.5 kB. The total keeps a new lazy chunk from hiding outside the named ones. Each project sets its own from its performance targets (docs/testing.md#performance-budget).

budgets.name: JavaScript, error tracking (lazy, only when configured)
